system.description:
An easy-to-use ranged weapon for those less experienced. If used by someone untrained in Ranged Combat (stock), they can instead use their Ranged Combat (short) Skill in its place.

Buttstroke: a spacer can use their stocked firearm as a bludgeoning melee weapon at -1DM and deal 1D+3 damage.

Stock Arms Ammo: each round costs 10cr and weighs 20g, or 50g per slug. For example, a carbine ammo cartridge weighs 600g and costs 300cr.

A powerful weapon popular for ship defense and boarding. Shotguns can be loaded with Spread ammo (Spread ammo decreases the weapon’s range from Long to Medium).

Buttstroke: a spacer can use their stocked firearm as a bludgeoning melee weapon at -1DM and deal 1D+3 damage.

Stock Arms Ammo: each round costs 10cr and weighs 20g, or 50g per slug. For example, a carbine ammo cartridge weighs 600g and costs 300cr.

Traits

  • Spread: Can use Spread ammo: decrease effective range by one range band; -1DM per target in range, damage split evenly between the targets hit.

A common firearm used for hunting, survival, and defense. Rifles are ideal for long-range use.

Buttstroke: a spacer can use their stocked firearm as a bludgeoning melee weapon at -1DM and deal 1D+3 damage.

Stock Arms Ammo: each round costs 10cr and weighs 20g, or 50g per slug. For example, a carbine ammo cartridge weighs 600g and costs 300cr.

Traits

  • Reliable: Ignore weapon-jamming if a 2 is rolled on an attack.

Semi-Auto Rifle: An entry-level military firearm. This weapon is capable of firing two rounds at a time within long range.

Buttstroke: a spacer can use their stocked firearm as a bludgeoning melee weapon at -1DM and deal 1D+3 damage.

Stock Arms Ammo: each round costs 10cr and weighs 20g, or 50g per slug. For example, a carbine ammo cartridge weighs 600g and costs 300cr.

Traits

  • Auto 3: Can be fired at a number of different targets during the same combat round, equal to the Auto number; always fires this amount of rounds. Multiple targets: -1DM per interval of Auto. Single target: the Auto number is added as damage on a hit. Suppression: +DM equal to the Auto number.

Sub-Machine Gun: A destructive military firearm capable of firing four rounds at a time.

Buttstroke: a spacer can use their stocked firearm as a bludgeoning melee weapon at -1DM and deal 1D+3 damage.

Stock Arms Ammo: each round costs 10cr and weighs 20g, or 50g per slug. For example, a carbine ammo cartridge weighs 600g and costs 300cr.

Traits

  • Auto 5: Can be fired at a number of different targets during the same combat round, equal to the Auto number; always fires this amount of rounds. Multiple targets: -1DM per interval of Auto. Single target: the Auto number is added as damage on a hit. Suppression: +DM equal to the Auto number.

Similar to the gauss pistol, but applied to a rifle. (Gauss pistol: this weapon accelerates the round using electromagnetic power to provide more damage.)

Buttstroke: a spacer can use their stocked firearm as a bludgeoning melee weapon at -1DM and deal 1D+3 damage.

Stock Arms Ammo: each round costs 10cr and weighs 20g, or 50g per slug. For example, a carbine ammo cartridge weighs 600g and costs 300cr.

Traits

  • Piercing 2: Reduces the Armour of the target by the listed number, to a minimum of 8+ to hit.
